name: C. Ramp servo mounted the wrong way
description: The right ramp servo was mounted the same way round as the left one, not mirrored. The code drives the two opposite ways (as mirrored servos need), so they fight: both buzz and the ramp hardly moves. Program 2's ramp step shows it: hold R2 and nothing goes out. Turn the servo round on its mount (Servos tab).

faults.text: The right ramp servo is mounted the same way as the left: the two turn against each other.
faults.caughtBy: 2 Motor Directions, step 5 (ramp): it buzzes and does not move; turn the right servo round
